liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Silver Cord** (2 other sources): Skipped a verse, quoting Converge and Pump Up The Jams [1][2]
- **Theia** (1 other source): Contained Motor Spirit [3]
- **Set** (1 other source): Included In Da Club and Dragon quotes [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Silver Cord**: rare: 13 archived performances [4]
- **Chang'e**: rare: 9 archived performances [4]
- **Swan Song**: rare: 14 archived performances [4]
- **Intrasport**: rare: 10 archived performances [4]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-11-06.silver-cord.matrix** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 8 songs; 109 min [1]. Said about its sound: Matrixed version is fuller, clearer, and feels like being there live [1]
- **kglw2024-11-06.bandcampbootlegger**: soundboard; 0 songs; 111 min [3]
- **kglw2024-11-06.silver-cord-4ch-mix**: source not stated; 8 songs; 109 min [2]

## Around the show

- Joey Walker performed an experimental rave set not included in the release [2]
- King Gizzard members listed include Amby Kenny-Smith, Mickey Cavanagh, and Cookie Craig [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-11-06.silver-cord.matrix**: taped by captainentropy; transferred by captainentropy; source: Source1: Nevaton MC59/W > Sound Devices MixPre-3 II (32/96); PAS, balcony center, clamped to rail Source2: Neumann AK50 caps > nBob actives > Naiant PFA > Zoom… [1]
- **kglw2024-11-06.bandcampbootlegger**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, Grace Reader, Gaspard De Meulemeester; source: SBD [3]
- **kglw2024-11-06.silver-cord-4ch-mix**: taped by captainentropy; transferred by captainentropy; source: Source1: Nevaton MC59/W > Sound Devices MixPre-3 II (32/96); PAS; balcony, center, clamped to rail / Source2: Neumann AK50 caps > nBob actives > Naiant PFA >… [2]

- Poster by Reverholic: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Silver Cord In Full Experimental Rave Set Poster For Show In San Francisco California](https://reverholic.com/product/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-silver-cord-in-full-experimental-rave-set-poster-for-show-in-san-francisco-california-at-the-regency-ballroom-on-november-6-2024-unisex-t-shirt/) [7]
- Poster by Wear It Loud Tee: [Official King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard At The Regency Ballroom In San Francisco, CA On November 6 2024 Poster Shirt](https://wearitloudtee.com/product/official-king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-at-the-regency-ballroom-in-san-francisco-ca-on-november-6-2024-poster-shirt/) [8]
